name: Allen & Heath dLive & iLive (dlive-ilive)
notes: Plain JavaScript module (actions.js, getActionDefinitions) that registers a different set of actions depending on the console model chosen in the connection config (dLive or iLive); the catalog lists every action of both sets and the availability text says for which model. The module defines no feedbacks.

Dropdown ids for strips are numbers: for a strip list of n entries from the offset ofs the ids are 1+ofs..n+ofs (muteOptions, phantomOptions, faderOptions and sendLevelOptions in actions.js:52-117 and 663-696). Fader levels are ids 0..127 (0 = -INF, then 0.5 dB steps from -53 dB to +10 dB). Lists longer than 40 entries are described in choicesNote with the id range.

The input channel, DCA and scene lists depend on the model: dLive 128 channels, 24 DCAs and 500 scenes, iLive 64 channels, 16 DCAs and 250 scenes (actions.js:14-16). Where the lists differ between the models the entry carries a note with both ranges.

Several fader and send actions include the fade duration fields (shared FadeDurationChoice in fades.js) although the module applies the fade only for some of them (sendActionWithFade for fader_input, fader_mono_group and the send actions; the other fader actions use sendAction).

The module has two repositories with overlapping scope: bitfocus/companion-module-allenheath-dlive (manifest id allenheath-dlive, TypeScript rewrite for dLive only) and this one (manifest id allenheath-dlive-ilive, dLive and iLive). Each manifest lists the other id under legacyIds; the source does not show which of them Companion currently installs for a new connection. Catalogued separately as allenheath-dlive and allenheath-dlive-ilive.
Package version 2.0.3 (the manifest still says 2.0.0). Built on @companion-module/base ^1.4.0 (1.x): option values do not support expressions, although some fields set isVisibleExpression.
Not catalogued: config fields, variables and the upgrade scripts.
